newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds spreads end firm, PCS junk off.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds spreads end firm, PCS junk off.

text.p: bond spreads held firm in quiet trade while news of competition from AT&T Corp sent high-yield bonds in the personal communications services (PCS) lower, dealers said. Both Nextel Communications Inc and Sprint Corp paper dropped roughly a point after AT&T said it plans to roll out its own digital PCS-like services next year.
"A lot of high-yield PCS companies weakened on that announcement," said one high-yield trader.
